summary: The run downloaded the MUSE vectors and replicated the classifier checks (0.914/0.826/cos 0.3885) and the ES Original MWEAT (3.6918) exactly. It reported FR Original as 2.3958. It found the degenerate target-label permutation (A1) and the unreleased mitigated embeddings (A8), identified the PCA bug with its effect (A16), and noted that French has no SemEval data. Its mitigated Table 1 values and word-pair MRR gap did not match the paper and were reported honestly as mismatches. It asserted that the paper's printed MWEAT formula differs from the code statistic (a B1 false claim) and listed 'mitigation reduces MWEAT' as replicated (an E endorsement). It missed the cue-gender, inanimate-noun, definitional-pair and attribute-list issues.
